findings.title: Survey Number & Subdivision Concordance
findings.explanation: Survey number 142 and subdivision 3A match identically across Patta #891, Sale Deed #2415/2018, and Village Cadastral Map.

findings.title: Property Extent Unit Reconciliation
findings.explanation: Sale Deed extent of 2.45 Acres (9,914.79 sq.m) matches the digital cadastral polygon boundary area of 9,912.40 sq.m within 0.02% allowable tolerance.
findings.suggestedAction: Extent verified against field measurement baseline.

findings.title: Subdivision Discrepancy Detected
findings.explanation: The registered Sale Deed #1892 refers to Survey No. 84/2B, whereas Revenue Patta #412 and A-Register show the applicant under 84/2A. No statutory subdivision order or FMB mutation note exists for 84/2B in taluk records.
findings.suggestedAction: Direct applicant to produce original Tahsildar Subdivision Order or call for Taluk Head Surveyor joint boundary survey.

findings.title: Material Extent Deficit (24.8% Shortage)
findings.explanation: Sale Deed claims title over 54,450 sq.ft (1.25 Acres / 5,058.57 sq.m), but digitized TSLR Ward 12 Block 4 and verified satellite parcel boundary encompass only 40,946 sq.ft (3,804.05 sq.m). Deficit of 13,504 sq.ft (0.31 Acre) detected on ground.
findings.suggestedAction: Require physical field verification with total station survey. Freeze planning permission endorsement pending discrepancy resolution.

findings.title: Incomplete Encumbrance Coverage Period
findings.explanation: Submitted EC only covers 2015 to 2023 (8 years). Regulatory verification requires 30 continuous years (1995 to 2025). The parent title transaction referenced in 2002 remains unverified for intervening charges.
missingPrerequisites: 30-Year Complete Encumbrance Certificate from SRO Sulur
findings.suggestedAction: Issue document requisition notice to applicant to submit 30-year online EC from Registration Department portal.

findings.title: Unreadable FMB Document Scan
findings.explanation: Uploaded FMB scan for Survey 302 is distorted by 45° skew and severe pixelation (<120 DPI). Ladder measurements and tie-line offset figures cannot be reliably extracted.
findings.suggestedAction: Request high-resolution 300 DPI flatbed scan or requisition digital FMB extract from Taluk Survey Archives.

findings.title: Applicant Initial / Lineage Mismatch
findings.explanation: Applicant is registered as "R. Sundaram", but the registered 1998 Deed vendor conveyance names "K. Sundaram". No Legal Heir Certificate or registered Rectification Deed has been produced to establish lawful linkage.
findings.suggestedAction: Require applicant to provide Legal Heir Certificate issued by Revenue Tahsildar or Registered Rectification Deed.

findings.title: Potential Duplicate Application Pending in Adjacent Register
findings.explanation: An identical survey number (Survey 118/2, Anamalai) has an active unresolved application (TN-REV-2025-CBE-99418) submitted by a different applicant (K. Muthusamy) claiming adverse possession in Revenue Taluk Office.
findings.suggestedAction: Do not approve unilateral patta issuance. Summon both claimants for enquiry under Section 10 of Patta Pass Book Act 1983.
